any_account.definition: Weighted percentage of respondents (16+) reporting an account registered in their own name with at least one provider among qf3_01–qf3_11 (commercial bank, digital bank, microfinance institution, NDFI, mobile money operator, Umurenge SACCO, insurance provider, pension fund administrator, EJOHEZA long-term savings scheme, savings group, village/community association).
any_account.denominator: All valid-weight respondents (16+) in the supplied release.

formal_account.definition: Weighted percentage holding an account with a formal regulated provider (qf3_01–qf3_09: banks, microfinance, NDFI, mobile money operator, Umurenge SACCO, insurance, pension, EJOHEZA), excluding savings groups and village associations.
formal_account.denominator: All valid-weight respondents (16+) in the supplied release.

commercial_bank_account.definition: Weighted percentage holding an account with a commercial bank or digital bank (qf3_01, qf3_02).
commercial_bank_account.denominator: All valid-weight respondents (16+) in the supplied release.

mobile_money_account.definition: Weighted percentage holding an account registered in their own name with a mobile money operator (qf3_05).
mobile_money_account.denominator: All valid-weight respondents (16+) in the supplied release.

umurenge_sacco_account.definition: Weighted percentage holding an Umurenge SACCO account (qf3_06).
umurenge_sacco_account.denominator: All valid-weight respondents (16+) in the supplied release.

mobile_money_current_use.definition: Weighted percentage currently using a mobile money operator (qf4_05).
mobile_money_current_use.denominator: All valid-weight respondents (16+) in the supplied release.

any_provider_ever.definition: Weighted percentage who report ever using at least one provider type listed in the QF1 battery (qf1_01–qf1_11). Equivalent to the complement of qf1_12 (none of the above). Definitionally narrower than the official 96% financial inclusion, which also counts device-based and indirect use.
any_provider_ever.denominator: All valid-weight respondents (16+) in the supplied release.

bank_ever.definition: Weighted percentage who report ever using a commercial bank (qf1_01). Official report benchmark: 22% banked adults.
bank_ever.denominator: All valid-weight respondents (16+) in the supplied release.

sacco_ever.definition: Weighted percentage who report ever using an Umurenge SACCO (qf1_06). Official report benchmark: 28% of adults hold a SACCO account in their own name.
sacco_ever.denominator: All valid-weight respondents (16+) in the supplied release.

mobile_money_ever.definition: Weighted percentage who report ever using a mobile money operator (qf1_05). This QF1 figure disagrees with the F module (f5) in the same release; the F-module measure is the cross-checkable one against the official report.
mobile_money_ever.denominator: All valid-weight respondents (16+) in the supplied release.

mobile_money_registered_current.definition: Weighted percentage whose f5 answer is code 6: registered current mobile-money user. The f5 codes are verified against the supplied questionnaire's mobile-money module. Official report benchmark: 77% of adults hold a registered mobile wallet in their own name.
mobile_money_registered_current.denominator: All valid-weight respondents (16+) in the supplied release.

mobile_money_ever_use.definition: Weighted percentage whose f5 answer indicates current or former mobile-money use (codes 4, 5 and 6: registered former user; unregistered current user; registered current user). Official report benchmark: 86% own or have used mobile money.
mobile_money_ever_use.denominator: All valid-weight respondents (16+) in the supplied release.

mobile_money_never_reached.definition: Weighted percentage whose f5 answer is code 1 (not heard of mobile money) or code 2 (not registered and has never used mobile money). Official report benchmark: 4% of adults are financially excluded.
mobile_money_never_reached.denominator: All valid-weight respondents (16+) in the supplied release.

official_report_benchmarks.note: Publisher values transcribed from report sections 2.1 (Figure 3, access strand) and the executive summary; documented for definition-aware comparison only, not as results of this extract.

limitations: Label text is transcribed from the release file itself; it documents question wording, not the official denominator policy of the publisher. Estimates built from these variables remain local exploratory results and are not comparable with the FinScope headline definitions unless explicitly cross-checked.
